translated_title: Mexico's Culture Ministry Announces Mass Book Purchase for the National Library Network
original_title: Cultura anuncia compra masiva de libros para la red nacional de bibliotecas
author: Alonso Urrutia
meta_description: A 50-million-peso call opens Monday for Mexican and independent publishers, paired with a zero-VAT rate for bookstores worth 200 million pesos a year.
